name: Quicken / known-blinding-suppresses-existing-token-trigger

Playing vanilla Wounding Blow red pays AP1 and creates only its attack layer; no Quicken trigger, destruction or grant occurs. Attack deals printed4, life16, AP0, Quicken remains.
